description.value: Gateway Grill is a casual, relaxed dining restaurant established in 2011 and located within the Quality Inn & Suites in Clearwater, BC. The restaurant actively courts tour groups, offering catering packages for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and meals to go, plus two private rooms seating up to 50 guests. Its position inside a hotel property makes it a convenient and group-ready dining stop for cyclists moving through the Clearwater corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at gatewaygrill.ca confirms an active restaurant at 368 Eden Rd, Clearwater, BC inside the Quality Inn & Suites, with phone 250-674-8758 consistent across all pages. The tour groups page explicitly offers 'Meals to go' supporting a takeout value; no other cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'K&A Gateway Grill' does not match the website branding of 'Gateway Grill' and 'Gateway Grill & Catering Co.', flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'K&A Gateway Grill' but the website consistently uses 'Gateway Grill' and 'Gateway Grill & Catering Co.' — the OSM name may be outdated or incorrect.
OSM has no address or phone populated; both are sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant in Clearwater, BC that explicitly serves tour groups with meal packages including meals to go — a practical and relevant stop for touring cyclists in the Cariboo/Central Interior region.

wow_evidence: located within the Quality Inn & Suites in Clearwater, BC
